title: Lagoon Rush
tagline: Skim the turquoise, chain the boosts, and out-drive three rivals to the lighthouse.
pitch: Lagoon Rush: a sunny tropical jet-boat race. Skim across a turquoise lagoon past palm beaches, a striped lighthouse and buoy-lined lanes, hit boost pads and a big jump ramp, and beat three rival boats over three laps. Bright, splashy, summery, toon colours.

plan.title: Lagoon Rush
plan.tagline: Skim the turquoise, chain the boosts, and out-drive three rivals to the lighthouse.
plan.core_loop: Steer a jet boat around the buoy-lined lagoon course, chain boost pads and the big jump ramp to build speed, grab starfish along the line, and out-drive three AI rivals over three laps.
plan.win_condition: Finish 3 laps in 1st place ahead of the three rival boats
plan.lose_condition: Cross the finish line in 2nd–4th place
plan.art_direction: Saturated noon-tropical palette: turquoise lagoon, sand-beige shores, coral red and sunny yellow accents, palm greens. Smooth toon shading with soft ink outlines, glossy water with white foam wakes, chunky rounded props. Bright postcard-summer mood — high contrast, hard noon sun, playful and splashy; references: cartoon island postcards and Mario Kart water stages.
concept_shots: The coral jet boat carves a white spray arc around a palm-fringed sandbar, three rival boats chasing in its wake, striped buoys bobbing along the lane and the striped lighthouse standing sentinel in the distance.

The boat rockets off the big ramp and hangs mid-air over the turquoise lagoon, spray trailing behind, a glowing arc of starfish pickups waiting along the jump's path, speed lines flaring at the screen edges.

Final lap: the player hits a glowing boost pad and surges past a rival at the lighthouse turn, splash particles bursting off the bow, a big FINAL LAP banner overhead and the checkered finish gate ahead.

assets.sky: Bright midday tropical sky: saturated azure fading to pale aqua at the horizon, big fluffy white cumulus puffs, warm sun glow, faint distant island silhouettes

assets.music: Upbeat tropical island pop: steel drums, ukulele strums, bright marimba and bongo percussion, 118 BPM, sunny and bouncy, seamless loop

Rising jet-whoosh with a zingy top note
Big soft cartoon water splash, low and thumpy
Cheery two-note lap ding, brass and marimba
Triumphant ukulele fanfare with a crowd cheer swell

props.name: lighthouse
props.prompt: A chunky striped lighthouse tower, alternating coral red and cream horizontal bands, rounded cap with a glowing yellow lamp room and a small balcony rail, thick rounded base

props.name: buoy
props.prompt: A small round bobbing buoy, glossy red-and-white horizontal stripes, a tiny yellow horn on top, chunky rounded shape

features: Boost pads along the lane trigger a speed burst: the level's boost placements + 'boost' hazard, with speed lines flaring and a jet-boost sfx
Big jump ramp mid-course: airtime over the lagoon with a splash burst on landing and a starfish arc placed along the jump path
Three AI rival boats in distinct hull colours (lime, violet, sand) with rubber-banding so the pack stays tight through all three laps
3-2-1-GO countdown with a horn, a FINAL LAP banner on the last lap, and a lap ding on every checkpoint (UI.countdown, UI.banner, checkpoint sfx)
Continuous white foam wake trail behind the boat plus splash particles on hard landings and buoy grazes (FX.trail, FX.splash)
Win screen with confetti, trophy and finish position; lose screen if you finish behind a rival (UI.winScreen, FX.confetti)
plan.mapping_notes: The lagoon level kind is a direct match for the pitch's turquoise lagoon, palm beaches and buoy-lined lanes, and the boat player kit stands in for the jet boat with a chase camera per the kit's boat convention. The striped lighthouse and buoys aren't part of the pre-dressed lagoon, so they're added as two generated voxel props: one lighthouse as the course landmark and eight striped buoys scattered along the lane. Boost pads and the jump ramp come from the level's boost/ramp placements plus the 'boost' hazard. The three rival boats are the race's AI opponents, not enemies, so enemies is 0. The kit has no 'fish' collectible tag, so the starfish pickups use the 'star' tag with a Starfish label and a starfish HUD icon. No lives and no timer: losing simply means finishing behind a rival, keeping the loop a pure, readable race.

operator_interventions: operator re-ran the asset stage for the 2 splats that failed (--backfill-assets) after a .spz conversion fix
operator re-ran the build from the scaffold stage (--redo scaffold) so game.js places the splats

result.summary:
Lagoon Rush: a sunny tropical jet-boat race. Skim across a turquoise lagoon past palm beaches, a striped lighthouse and buoy-lined lanes, hit boost pads and a jump ramp, and beat three rival boats over three laps. Bright, splashy, summery toon colours.

The scaffold already produced a working lagoon race; I tuned it into the planned game:
- Kept the lagoon level (medium), boat player in coral-red/yellow, chase camera, and the generated lighthouse + buoy props and Gaussian-splat landmarks placed beside the route.
- Starfish pickups (star tag, target 12 of 24) with the generated starfish HUD icon.
- 3-lap race vs 3 AI rivals (kit rubber-banding keeps the pack tight), arcade HUD with lap, position, speedometer, timer, minimap and objective.
- Custom win/lose screens (winScreen/loseScreen: false on the HUD, driven by rules onWin/onLose) showing finish position, laps, starfish and time — win in 1st, lose if out-raced.
- Plan juice: continuous white foam wake trail behind the boat, splash burst + shake on hard landings, speed-line flare on boost, and a star pop on each starfish pickup.
- Title screen sells the fantasy with the tagline, controls credit and a 3-2-1-GO countdown.
changes: Added onWin/onLose callbacks to Gameplay.rules with custom K.UI.winScreen / K.UI.loseScreen showing finish position, laps, starfish and time; disabled the HUD's automatic win/lose screens (winScreen/loseScreen: false)
Added a continuous white foam wake trail behind the boat (K.FX.trail)
Wired event juice: splash + shake on hard landings, speed-lines on boost, starBurst on starfish collect
Tuned HUD objective text and title-screen subtitle to the plan
known_issues: The generated lagoon's backdrop reads more grassy-meadow than turquoise-postcard; the water, buoys, palms and lighthouse carry the tropical theme but the shoreline hills stay green
Autopilot tends to sit 3rd/4th (AI rubber-banding), so the win screen is hard to trigger in an autopilot run — the lose screen path is the more common autopilot outcome
